evidence.detail: AnimationCurve decodes two rs/u/i values directly before its keyframes and stores them separately as the modes used when sampling below the first keyframe and above the last keyframe.
Out-of-range curve evaluation switches on these modes to choose endpoint hold or alternate repeated/cyclic, offset and reflected/ping-pong style extrapolation paths before re-evaluating the curve.
rs/u/i is an enum-like five-instance value set resolved from one encoded integer and has no state or consumers outside this curve boundary/extrapolation role.

proposals.note: CurveExtrapolationMode is a conservative semantic recovery name for the exact v308 pre/post-keyframe curve behavior enum; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
